svg.title: VYBEIN A-SWY fragrance profile
svg.desc: An arch-shaped VYBEIN A-SWY scent profile with its 50 ml perfume, main accords, photographs of Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Vanilla, Chestnut accord, and an 8.5-hour longevity detail.
svg.text: Aromatic spice, creamy sweetness and chestnut create a warm embrace.
